name: marketing-performance
description: The campaign workspace every creative plugin works in: marketing briefs, copywriting, campaign operations, Google Analytics 4 funnel analysis and documented UTM planning in the current workspace.

interface.shortDescription: Plan campaigns, write copy, track UTMs and analyze GA4
interface.longDescription: Draft evidence-backed marketing briefs, explore multi-voice ad and social copy, analyze Google Analytics 4 (GA4) and Firebase campaign funnels, and organize dated campaign workspaces with Meta Ads hierarchies, social media trees, timestamped performance reports and validated UTM tracking.
defaultPrompt: Use marketing-brief to turn our product facts and goal into a campaign brief.
Use campaign-manager to set up a dated campaign workspace with Meta Ads, social media, UTM links and performance reports.
Use google-analytics-analyst to analyze our GA4 campaign funnel, UTM sessions and post-click conversions.
